title: Jacked Cat Torso-Limb Split
author: alicelea
desc:
build some baseline muscle and strength in your apartment or hotel gym! start with a comfortably light weight that you can perform the maximum number of reps for with each set. once you can do 12 good reps without significant form breakdown increase the weight.

you’ll probably max out the goblet squats or bench press before anything else, at which point you should increase volume, find a more difficult variation or sign up for a gym membership! 

please add two days of your preferred cardio each week and consider adding a brief mobility routine before you lift.

ss.note: use this to pre-exhaust your pecs, don’t go super heavy
keep a nice 45° angle and get a nice deep stretch
don’t go super heavy, just blast your delts!
use any row variation you like!

ex.note: keep your weight on your heels, keep upright and push up from the floor with your quads
you should feel in control of your body and the weight at all times!

ss.note: use any bicep curl variation you like! the last set is a drop set, use a lighter weight and go for as many reps as possible. if you can get 20 reps then you should increase the weight!
use any triceps isolation you like! the last set is a drop set, use a lighter weight and go for as many reps as possible. if you can get 20 reps then you should increase the weight!

ex.note: start with a heavy band until you can get 10 clean reps, then progress to medium. repeat this process until you’re able to do bodyweight chin-ups. add a set of bodyweight negatives if possible.

ss.note: don’t go super heavy on these, save that for benching! use these to really engage and exhaust your chest muscles
nice 45° angle, get a deep stretch
rest your upper back perpendicular on the bench, engage your core and keep your hips up. pull across the bench for maximum stretch
if you don’t like bent over rows try another variation! chest supported rows, single arm rows, or cable rows if that’s an option for you!
the last set is a drop set, use a lighter weight and go to town!
the last set is a drop set, use a lighter weight and go to town!

ex.note: if you can hold for 90 seconds add weight! aim to increase the time you hold for by 5 seconds each week
